description: A UniFi gateway's local DNS records, its DNS Records, through the UniFi Network API: of a UniFi OS console, as a UDM, UDR, UCG or UXG, or of UniFi OS Server, with an API key or a user; or of a self-hosted UniFi Network Application, with a user. The names are records, one for each address, which the gateway answers to the devices that use it as their DNS server. UniFi Network 8.2.93 or later. A record of the name that you disabled, or of another type, as a CNAME, is left as it is.

address.description: The address of the console, as https://192.168.1.1, or of the self-hosted Network Application, as https://192.168.1.2:8443.

tls_fingerprint.description: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the console's certificate, as 64 hex digits, colons allowed, for when it can't be verified otherwise: a console's own certificate is signed by itself. Without it, the certificate must be valid.

api_key.description: An API key of UniFi OS: in the console, Settings, Control Plane, Integrations, Create API Key. Its user must be allowed to change the network's settings. A self-hosted Network Application has no API keys: give username and password instead.

username.description: A local user that may change the network's settings, instead of api_key. Without two-factor authentication: ipv6ddns can't answer it.

site.description: The site, by its name in the API: default unless you made others. Default: default.

zone.description: The domain the names are under, as lan.example.com. UniFi has no zones: it is only what a name written alone, as nas, is completed with.

ttl.description: The records' TTL, as 5m or 1h, a day at most. Default: none, which the gateway answers with a TTL of its own.
